title: TEHRAN, Oct16, General Bagherzadeh made remarks On the latest status of the Iranian pilots missing since the war.
text:
TEHRAN, Oct16, General Bagherzadeh made remarks On the latest status of the Iranian pilots missing since the war."

""
"———-"

"SOT, General Mohammad Baqerzadeh, Commander of the Search Committee for the Missing in the Armed Forces (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:39): “Since the follow-up process is being pursued both directly through the diplomatic officials of the country and through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Interior, they [Qataris] promised that a second expert team would visit Manzil, the issue is that the findings of the first team's investigation did not provide assurance to our expert team regarding the statements and claims made by the Qatari officials, and they failed to convince us.”"

"SOT, General Mohammad Baqerzadeh, Commander of the Search Committee for the Missing in the Armed Forces (Farsi) (00:40 - 01:15): “The responsibility lies with the person serving as the pilot and the head of the dispatched expert group; he has reviewed at least 100 flight hours so far and has noticed their unacceptable remarks, meaning the claims they made were unacceptable, and this has been reported to the relevant authorities in our country. There are reasons, at least regarding this matter, which I do not wish to elaborate on right now.”"

""
"SOT, General Mohammad Baqerzadeh, Commander of the Search Committee for the Missing in the Armed Forces (Farsi) (01:16 - 01:53): “The second team has again, meaning once more, accepted that the team must leave. This is the first aspect. Regarding the Red Cross, I personally followed up and had a meeting with the Red Cross officials in Tehran. The new head of the Red Cross office in Tehran, Ms. Marisel Chao, agreed to pursue the matter more seriously and accepted from our side that this is a serious issue that must be resolved.”"

""
"SOT, General Mohammad Baqerzadeh, Commander of the Search Committee for the Missing in the Armed Forces ( Farsi) (01:54 - 02:09): “The Qatar issue is a very serious matter. We have transferred what we knew to the Qataris in terms of the expertise and information we possessed, and this is not something that remains hidden from the view of the Islamic Republic.”
